risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading the Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) and Short Circuit Current (Isc) in direct sunlight.

risks.risk: The panel may be physically damaged (cracks, delamination) or have internal hot spots.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the glass surface and the back of the panel.
